secondaryText: Translate "buenos dias" and say when you would use it.
Label the four chambers of the heart from memory.
Solve 3x + 5 = 20 and explain each step out loud.
Name the first ten elements of the periodic table.
List five state capitals in under 30 seconds.
Rewrite the sentence using the past perfect tense.
Define mitosis and identify its main stages.
Build a C major triad and identify each note.
Explain the difference between `map` and `filter`.
State one cause and one outcome of the French Revolution.
Use "ephemeral" correctly in an original sentence.
Describe Newton's second law in plain language.
Identify the primary colors and one secondary color.
Convert 3/4 to a decimal and percentage.
Conjugate "etre" in the present tense.
Summarize the main idea of a paragraph in one sentence.
Define "ubiquitous" and give one real-world example.
Write pseudocode for checking if a number is even.
Name the three main rock types and one example of each.
Practice a 20-second explanation of your favorite topic.
